Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=8: continue
            # square check

            # triomino: unique 2x2 window with exactly 3 eights

            occ=[(a,b) for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1) if I[r+i+a][c+j+b]==8]
            miss=tuple(sorted(set((a,b) for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1)))-set(occ))[0]
            # map missing corner -> color per demo (learned below)
            O[r][c]=MISS[miss]
    return O

import collections, itertools
def feat(I,O,p):
    # one row per 8-cell: features + color
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    rows=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=8: continue
            f={}
            # windows
            wins=[]
            for ti,tj in [(-1,-1),(-1,0),(0,-1),(0,0)]:
                if 0<=r+ti<H-1 and 0<=c+tj<W-1:
                    n=sum(1 for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1) if I[r+ti+a][c+tj+b]==8)
                    wins.append(n)
            f['sq']=any(w==4 for w in wins)
            f['tris']=[tuple(sorted(((a,b) for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1) if I[r+ti+a][c+tj+b]==8))) for ti,tj in [(-1,-1),(-1,0),(0,-1),(0,0)] if 0<=r+ti<H-1 and 0<=c+tj<W-1 and sum(1 for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1) if I[r+ti+a][c+tj+b]==8)==3]
            # nearest square cell & direction (global: cells in full 2x2)
            sqcells=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if any(0<=rr+a<H-1 and 0<=cc+b<W-1 and all(I[rr+a+i][cc+b+j]==8 for i in(0,1) for j in(0,1)) for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1))]
            if sqcells:
                best=min(sqcells,key=lambda p_:abs(p_[0]-r)+abs(p_[1]-c))
                dr=best[0]-r; dc=best[1]-c
                f['d_dir']= ('H' if abs(dr)<=abs(dc) else 'V', 'R' if dc>0 else ('L' if dc<0 else ('U' if dr<0 else 'D')))
            else: f['d_dir']=None
            # parity
            f['pr']=r%2; f['pc']=c%2; f['pd']=(r+c)%2
            f['rcol']=c; f['rrow']=r
            rows.append((f,O[r][c]))
    return rows
allrows=[]
for p in (1,2,3):
    allrows.extend(feat(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output'],p))
# find simple separators: try candidate single features
cands=['sq','d_dir','pr','pc','pd','rcol','rrow']
for k in cands:
    tab=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    for f,col in allrows: tab[(f[k],col)][col]+=1
    bad={kk:v for kk,v in tab.items() if len(v)>1}

    n4=sum(1 for a,b in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+a<H and 0<=c+b<W and I[r+a][c+b]==8)

    n8=sum(1 for a in range(-1,2) for b in range(-1,2) if (a or b) and 0<=r+a<H and 0<=c+b<W and I[r+a][c+b]==8)
    # completions: windows where this cell is TL/TR/BL/BR and all4=8

import json
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
I=G['Test input']
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    out=[[1]*W for _ in range(H)]
    used=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # maximal solid 2x2 squares -> color 1 (out already 1, mark)
    for a in range(H-1):
        for b in range(W-1):
            if all(I[a+i][b+j]==8 for i in(0,1) for j in(0,1)):
                for x,y in [(a+i,b+j) for i in(0,1) for j in(0,1)]: used[x][y]=True
    # remaining 8-cells into connected components
    rem=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==8 and not used[r][c]]
    from collections import deque
    while rem:
        start=rem.pop(); comp={start}; q=deque([start])
        while q:
            x,y=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and (nx,ny) in set(rem)|set(comp) and I[nx][ny]==8 and (nx,ny) not in comp:
                    comp.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
        rem-=comp
        col=max(range(1,len(used)-sum(row.count(True) for row in used)+1))
        for x,y in comp: out[x][y]=col
    return out
for p in (1,2,3):
    ok = solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p,ok)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
